user.title: Configure Smart Fan Controller
user.description: Select a climate entity with fan modes. Auto-calibration will run for 48 h to optimize settings.

data_description.climate_entity: Must come from a Versatile Thermostat.
data_description.learning_enabled: Enable automatic learning of optimal parameters. When ready, settings will be applied automatically.
data_description.data_collection: Records one CSV row every 2 minutes in the Home Assistant config folder, alongside configuration.yaml: smart_fan_controller_data_XXXXXXXX.csv (max 10 MB, auto-rotated). Useful for reproducing algorithm behaviour and identifying improvements during the beta phase.
data_description.mpc_shadow_enabled: Runs the learned model + MPC-lite in the background for comparison only. No real fan command is applied from the shadow controller.
data_description.defrost_entity: Optional: binary sensor, sensor or input_boolean that indicates when the heat pump is in defrost mode. Leave empty to use automatic detection.
data_description.operating_entity: Optional: binary sensor, sensor or input_boolean that indicates when the heat pump compressor is actively running. Used to prevent useless fan changes while the compressor is off.
data_description.power_entity: Optional: sensor that reports the heat pump power consumption in watts. Used as a fallback to detect compressor idle when no operating entity is configured.
data_description.idle_power_threshold: Power below this threshold (in watts) means the compressor is idle. Default: 20 W.

error.invalid_climate_entity: This entity must come from Versatile Thermostat.
error.invalid_thresholds: Deadband must be less than Soft Error, which must be less than Hard Error.
